systems.system: DHIS2 Tracker configuration for Ebola response
systems.owner: Ministry of Health, with HISP DRC, RTI International and the Public Health Emergency Operations Centre (COUSP)
Ministry of Health with HISP DRC, HISP UiO and Africa CDC

note: Every DHIS2 use described for DR Congo is surveillance or outbreak case tracking: the Ebola Tracker made operational within 24 hours of the declaration of 15 May 2026, and earlier Ebola (2025) and mpox (2024) responses. No routine aggregate reporting and no patient record system is described.
